given: no stock records have been filed
when: the operator opens the home screen
then: an explicit "No stock at this location" message is shown instead of a blank page

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 concern the populated table and its column formatting; this AC asserts the empty-state behavior when there is no data. The empty-state message can be missing (blank page) while the populated table renders correctly, and vice versa, so each is independently breakable.

architectural_notes: E2E: the empty-data path spans the React SPA home page and the JSON read endpoint (app/routes/ -> app/services/ -> app/repositories/) returning an empty collection against real DB state with no stock rows. The service returns an empty list (never an error), and the SPA renders the explicit empty-state message rather than a blank region (nfrs.md clean-render preference). Verified through the real-branch pytest-bdd suite (endpoint returns empty JSON) plus the SPA component test asserting the message; owner: home-table view in client/ over the stock read route.
